_comment: Ground-truth sentences for local STT accuracy measurement. Synthesised with Windows SAPI by scripts/make-test-corpus.ps1, so the reference text is exactly known. Chosen to mirror what SpeakFlow actually hears: professional call sentences with deadlines, numbers, technical terms and clarifications. Synthetic speech only - no real call audio, no private data.

sentences.text: Can you explain why the application is taking longer to load today
sentences.note: the original single-sentence test; plain question

sentences.text: We need to move the deadline to Friday because the API integration slipped
sentences.note: deadline plus a technical term (API) plus a cause

sentences.text: I am not sure what you mean by that exactly could you clarify
sentences.note: clarification request; a fast-path library category

sentences.text: Could you confirm the next step and who is picking it up
The audio is breaking up a little on my side can you repeat that
sentences.note: audio trouble; hard words for a small model

sentences.text: Our team can deliver the first milestone by the end of next week
That estimate was based on the original scope we agreed in January
I will check with the backend team and get back to you tomorrow
sentences.note: the safest holding reply; very common in the reply library

sentences.text: We also need to add reporting to the same sprint
sentences.note: scope creep; an out-of-scope library category

sentences.text: Thanks for the update I appreciate you flagging that early
